title: Cheapest Payment Gateway for Shopify in India: How To Choose a High ROI PG for Shopify
summary: Find the cheapest payment gateway for Shopify in India and learn how to choose a high-ROI PG based on TDR, success rate, UPI, fees, and settlements.
body_markdown:
## How do you choose a best-value payment gateway for a Shopify store in India?


The best-value payment gateway for a Shopify store should fit your customers’ payment preferences and your total monthly cost. Razorpay is a strong choice for an Indian store that wants UPI, cards, wallets and net banking through its[documented Shopify app](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/payment-gateway/ecommerce-plugins/shopify/) , without building a custom payment connection.


Compare your quoted gateway rate, Shopify’s plan-specific third-party transaction fee and optional charges using the same sales volume. Razorpay’s[standard domestic platform rate is 2% plus applicable GST](https://razorpay.com/pricing/) ; choose it when the supported checkout and operating workflow justify the complete cost for your store.


Use the[Shopify cost guide](https://razorpay.com/blog/shopify-payment-gateway-cost-india/) for the calculation and the[installation guide](https://razorpay.com/blog/how-to-add-payment-gateway-in-shopify/) for setup. Recurring billing through Subscriptions and marketplace splits through Route are not supported by the standard Razorpay Shopify plugin.


## Which payment gateway is cheapest for Shopify in India?


Compare the complete cost for the same payment mix and successful sales volume. Include gateway fees, applicable tax, fixed charges and optional services. A lower rate is cheaper when other costs and outcomes are equal; use measured business benefits rather than an assumed success-rate advantage to evaluate additional value.


## Evaluate Razorpay for your Shopify store’s actual needs


Razorpay provides the methods and app connection described at the top of this guide. Compare[standard gateway pricing](https://razorpay.com/pricing/) and the actual Shopify charges before deciding whether it provides the best value for your store. Additional checkout products need their own scope and pricing checks.


## How do you activate Razorpay on Shopify?


Use the[All-in-one Razorpay Payment Gateway app](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/payment-gateway/ecommerce-plugins/shopify/) . Complete the account and website-review prerequisites, then connect using the Razorpay account owner’s access. API keys are not required for this app connection. Follow the current integration instructions and test the checkout before live use. The standard plugin supports Payment Gateway, not Route or Subscriptions.


## Why do Shopify merchants in India pay more than merchants in other countries?


Merchants in Shopify Payments markets can use the native processor and avoid third-party transaction fees entirely. Indian merchants cannot. This structural difference is the single largest driver of higher payment costs for Shopify stores in India.


### Is Shopify Payments available in India?


No.[Shopify Payments is not available in India](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments) . India is not among the supported markets for the native processor. As a result, 100% of Indian Shopify merchants must integrate a third-party payment gateway. There is no workaround. This is the root cause of the cost stack below, and it is why the[Shopify payment gateway cost in India](https://razorpay.com/blog/shopify-payment-gateway-cost-india/) is structurally higher than in Shopify Payments markets.


### What are Shopify third-party transaction fees by plan?


Use the rate for your current plan in[Shopify’s billing documentation](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/your-account/manage-billing/billing-charges/types-of-charges/third-party-charges/third-party-transaction-fees) . The transaction-fee calculation is separate from gateway processing charges. Do not assume a single surcharge for all plans.


## What is the real cost of a Shopify payment gateway in India?


Use three lines in your estimate:


1. **Razorpay gateway charges:** apply your contracted rate to the relevant successful payment value and add applicable tax.
2. **Shopify charges:** use the third-party transaction fee shown for your plan and the calculation basis in[Shopify’s billing documentation](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/your-account/manage-billing/billing-charges/types-of-charges/third-party-charges/third-party-transaction-fees) .
3. **Other costs:** add your Shopify subscription and any optional services you choose.


For example, ₹1 lakh of successful domestic gateway payments at Razorpay’s standard 2% platform rate produces ₹2,000 in gateway fees before GST. Add the Shopify amount calculated for your actual plan; do not assume every store pays a further 2%.


Compare plans using the same order volume, payment mix and tax treatment. A plan upgrade is worthwhile only when the benefits and any fee savings exceed the additional subscription cost.

## Is UPI free on Shopify payment gateways?


Not entirely, and this is one of the most misunderstood points in Indian payments. The government mandates a Zero MDR policy on standard bank-to-bank UPI and RuPay debit card transactions, but “Zero MDR” does not mean “zero cost to the merchant” on every gateway.


### Standard UPI versus platform fees


Under the Zero MDR policy, the issuing and acquiring banks cannot charge an interchange fee for a standard UPI transfer. However, gateways still apply a platform or technology fee for the dashboard, reporting, reconciliation, and secure infrastructure. The[UPI charges explainer on MDR versus platform fees](https://razorpay.com/blog/upi-charges-explained-mdr-vs-platform-fees/) clarifies that a standard platform fee, often mapping to the 2% standard rate, applies even when the bank-level MDR is zero. So merchants should not assume UPI is entirely free.


### RuPay credit card on UPI and higher-fee cases


There is an important exception. When a customer pays via a RuPay credit card linked to a UPI app, the transaction is not covered by the Zero MDR policy. In this case a gateway charges 2.15% plus GST. Merchants promoting UPI as a low-cost method should account for the RuPay-credit-on-UPI case separately, because it can carry a higher fee than a standard debit UPI transfer.


## How do you choose a high ROI payment gateway for Shopify?


Use completed-order contribution after gateway, Shopify and operating costs. Compare the same period and payment mix, and include only measured benefits in the base case. Product eligibility and integration requirements matter alongside price.

### Why does Shopify charge an extra transaction fee in India?


Because[Shopify Payments is not available in India](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments) , every Indian merchant must use a third-party gateway. This triggers[Shopify’s third-party transaction fee](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/your-account/manage-billing/billing-charges/types-of-charges/third-party-charges/third-party-transaction-fees) of 2% on Basic, 1% on Grow, and 0.6% on Advanced, charged on top of your gateway MDR.


### Is Shopify Payments available in India?


No. India is not a supported market for Shopify Payments. All Indian Shopify merchants must integrate a third-party gateway, which is the structural reason payment costs are higher for Indian stores.


### Is UPI free on Shopify payment gateways?


Standard bank-to-bank UPI carries Zero MDR at the bank level, but gateways still apply a platform fee for processing and infrastructure, often mapping to the 2% standard rate. A RuPay credit card on UPI is an exception and can attract 2.15% plus GST, so UPI is not universally free.


### What is MDR?


MDR, or Merchant Discount Rate, is the percentage fee a gateway charges on each transaction. In India it typically ranges from 1.5% to 3.5% depending on the payment method, with UPI and debit generally lower than credit cards and EMI.


### Does GST apply to payment gateway fees?


Yes. Every payment gateway fee in India attracts 18% GST. This means a 2% MDR becomes an effective 2.36% once GST is added, which is why comparing pre-GST headline rates understates the true cost.


### Can I use two payment gateways on Shopify?


Yes. Shopify allows multiple gateways in your payment settings. Many Indian stores run one domestic gateway for Indian customers and a separate provider for international buyers.
